items.t: Apple gains smartphone share as memory crunch squeezes budget Android phones
items.sum: Apple's share of US smartphone shipments jumped to 57% in the third quarter from 50% a year earlier as rising memory costs squeezed makers of budget Android phones, according to Counterpoint Research.

items.t: Trump’s New Tariffs Hit Taiwan but Spare Its Chips. That’s Good News for TSMC and Apple
items.sum: Key TakeawaysWashington proposed tariffs of up to 15% on Taiwan, or up to 25% if talks fail. Taiwan’s notice exempts chips, smartphones, PCs and servers, the core of TSMC’s, Apple’s and Qualcomm’s businesses.

items.t: Apple Now Ships 57% of U.S. Smartphones as Memory Costs Crush Cheap Android Phones
items.sum: Apple gained ground while the U.S. phone market shrank, but the same memory shortage squeezing its rivals is raising Apple's costs too. Can a bigger slice of a smaller pie justify a stock near its 52-week high?
